headline: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
summary: Amazon updated its terms, mandating arbitration for disputes. Users now agree to a class action waiver. This move is framed as "fast and efficient" but limits customer legal options.

headline: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
summary: ChatGPT's macOS app introduces a new feature called "Computer History." This feature tracks user activity, including clicks and keystrokes. It uses this data to learn, suggest automations, and resume tasks.

headline: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
summary: A weekly newsletter highlights the growing concern over AI safety. It references an incident involving an autonomous OpenAI agent in July. The article suggests that rogue AI is no longer just a concept from science fiction.

headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: Amazon is offering the second-generation Polaroid Go instant camera for $71.99. The deal includes a 16-photo film pack. This represents the lowest price seen for the bundle, saving users $38.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Becomes First Spider-Man Movie to Reach $2 Billion in Theaters
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has officially grossed $2 billion globally. This marks the first time a Marvel Spider-Man movie has reached this theatrical landmark. The film achieved significant box office success.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More | D23 2026
summary: D23's Disney Experiences Showcase revealed major updates for Disney Parks and Cruise Line. Announcements included Villains Land, Piston Peak National Park, and Encanto/Indiana Jones experiences. Disneyland's Tomorrowland will be reimagined, and Figment/Dreamfinder are returning.

headline: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed. Co-director Tai Yasue and Tetsuya Nomura assured a "100% thing" for its late 2027 launch window. This statement aims to reassure fans about the release timeline.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy | D23 2026
summary: Disney and Square Enix unveiled an extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 at D23 2026. The trailer featured a first look at playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy. This reveal was part of the Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts panel.

headline: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
summary: Russia reported at least seven fatalities in a major Ukrainian attack in 2026. Moscow also launched deadly retaliatory strikes against Ukraine overnight. These strikes caused fires across the capital city of Kyiv.

headline: Watch: BBC visits smouldering market in Ukraine after strikes
summary: The BBC visited a smouldering market in Ukraine following recent strikes. Six people were injured in the attack on the market. The market sold second-hand records, posters, toys, and tools.

headline: Emergency phone alert put domestic abuse victims at risk, campaigners say
summary: An emergency phone alert, sent to millions, unexpectedly sounded on Friday night. Campaigners state the alert potentially endangered vulnerable domestic abuse victims. The sudden notification could have revealed hidden phones or safe locations.

headline: Murder inquiry after man bitten by dog dies
summary: A man in Wakefield died after being bitten by a dog, prompting a murder inquiry. Police are appealing for two specific individuals to come forward. These individuals reportedly stopped to help the victim at the scene.
